fields.description: Issue focuses on Miami city commission run-off election politics, urging voter turnout and supporting incumbent commissioners; includes discussion of proposed consolidation of city and county tax assessor offices and potential increases in residential taxes and water rates. Coverage also addresses Florida sales tax opposition and illegal off-track betting, commentary on a Dade County grand jury crime report and law enforcement, local civic concerns (including Bayfront Park), and assorted local columns, legal notices, and entertainment advertising.
